StartDateParam: The first UTC calendar day to include. Only used when UseDateRange is True.
Enter YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-09-24 (24 September 2026). The window starts at 00:00 UTC on this date.
EndDateParam: The last UTC calendar day to include. Only used when UseDateRange is True.
Enter YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-09-24 (24 September 2026). This includes the entire selected UTC day, ending just before 00:00 UTC on the following day.
